gloss: to recognize; to perceive; to be aware of

definitions.explanation: To identify or distinguish something, especially through sensory or technological means.

definitions.gloss: to perceive; to be aware of; to understand
definitions.explanation: To grasp or become conscious of a fact, situation, or problem.

notes:
A versatile word used in both technical and abstract contexts. In computing and technology, it refers to identification and detection. In everyday and formal speech, it describes awareness and understanding of situations or facts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦{認識|にんしき}→認識：05090_ninshiki⟧: facial recognition
- ⟦{音声|おんせい}{認識|にんしき}→音声認識：15961_onseininshiki⟧: voice recognition
- ⟦{現状|げんじょう}→現状：02721_genjou⟧⟦{認識|にんしき}→認識：05090_ninshiki⟧: understanding of the current situation
- ⟦{認識|にんしき}→認識：05090_ninshiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{甘|あま}い→甘い：00617_amai⟧: to underestimate; to have insufficient awareness
- ⟦{認識|にんしき}→認識：05090_ninshiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{改|あらた}める→改める：12923_aratameru⟧: to revise one's understanding

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{理解|りかい}する→理解する：06059_rikaisuru⟧: to understand — focuses on comprehension of meaning or content
- ⟦{把握|はあく}する→把握する：19628_haakusuru⟧: to grasp — implies firm understanding of details and scope
- ⟦{意識|いしき}する→意識する：17974_ishikisuru⟧: to be conscious of — implies deliberate attention to something
